newsitem.title: CANADA: Bank of Canada sets 2nd round of specials at 3.25.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Canada sets 2nd round of specials at 3.25.

text.p: The Bank of Canada conducted a second round of special purchase and resale agreements in the money markets on Monday at 3.25 percent, dealers said.
Dealers said the central bank intervened a second time to add some liquidity to the system in hopes of easing the upward pressure on the overnight rate.
They said the lack of cash drove the overnight rate against the upper limit of the central bank's 50 basis point target range at 3.25 percent.
They said upward pressure could continue in the wake of today's government of Canada T-bill tender.
